title: Over a local ring whose etale algebras retract through rational points, a finite type algebra splits off a finite factor (Stacks 04GG (8)$\Rightarrow$(11))
statement: Let $(R,\mathfrak m,\kappa)$ be a local ring such that for every ring map $R\to R'$ with $\operatorname{Spec}R'\to\operatorname{Spec}R$ etale [def-weil-etale-morphism] and every prime ideal $\mathfrak m'\subset R'$ lying over $\mathfrak m$ with $\kappa\to\kappa(\mathfrak m')$ an isomorphism [def-weil-residue-field] there is an $R$-algebra homomorphism $\tau:R'\to R$ with $\tau^{-1}(\mathfrak m)=\mathfrak m'$. Let $R\to S$ be a ring map of finite type [def-weil-pbc-finite-type-algebra]. Then there are $R$-algebras $A$ and $B$ (either of which may be $0$) and an isomorphism of $R$-algebras $S\cong A\times B$ such that $A$ is a finitely generated $R$-module and $R\to B$ (of finite type, $B$ being a quotient of $S$) is not quasi-finite [def-weil-pbc-ring-map-quasi-finite-at-prime] at any prime ideal of $B$ lying over $\mathfrak m$.

source.place: Algebra, Lemma Tag 04GG (lemma-characterize-henselian, line 42115), proof of 8$\Rightarrow$11 (line 42224), using Lemma Tag 00UK (lemma-etale-makes-quasi-finite-finite, line 40362)

proof.text: Apply [lem-weil-pbc-finite-type-etale-finite-factor-decomposition] to S at the maximal ideal. Unpack the etale coefficient algebra R', its prime P over the maximal ideal, the finite factor A', the finite-type factor B', and the product equivalence e. Retain the residue-field bijectivity and the absence of quasi-finite points of B' over P.

Lift R' to ULift in Type (max u v) and pull P back along the algebra equivalence. The two induced residue-field maps are inverse, as verified on coefficient elements by residue-field extensionality [def-weil-residue-field]. Compose the original residue-field bijection with this equivalence. Transport etaleness [def-weil-etale-morphism] and apply hR to the lifted algebra. Compose the resulting retraction with the inverse lift to get tau : R' -> R with P = tau^{-1}(m).

Give R its R'-algebra structure through tau, with scalar tower R -> R' -> R. Put A0 = R tensor_{R'} A' and B0 = R tensor_{R'} B'. Tensor cancellation [lem-weil-pbc-tensor-cancel-base-change], tensor congruence and binary product distribution [lem-weil-pbc-algebra-tensor-product-distributes-product] give S isomorphic to A0 times B0. Each projection is surjective from S, so both factors are Small in the universe of S; construct A and B by Shrink, transporting the product equivalence. Module finiteness of A0 is the base-change instance; transport it to A. The projection S -> B gives finite type of B.

Apply the fully proved [lem-weil-pbc-retraction-base-change-no-quasi-finite] to tau, P and the equivalence from B0 to B. It transports the absence of quasi-finite points of B' over P to B over m, completing the conjunction and existential witnesses.

proof_origin.place: Algebra Tag 04GG, proof of (8) => (11), using Tag 00UK; F4 formalizes the tensor construction and universe adapters. The omitted closed-fibre verification is proved by restricting the spectrum embedding of the tensor quotient, instead of constructing a residue-field tensor equivalence. Source read online at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/04GG and https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/00UK.
